about.llc.title: About "Solsynth LLC"
about.llc.p1: We used to call ourselves "Solsynth LLC" because it looks prettier in typography.
about.llc.p2: However, since we're not a registered company, the founder quickly realized the legal risk and removed this expression.
about.llc.p3: Please do not use "Solsynth LLC" when referencing us. At least not now.

solarNetwork.tagline: A serene social network that makes self-expression and connecting with others simple and pure.
solarNetwork.about.title: About Solar Network
solarNetwork.about.desc: Solian (also known as Solar Network) is a social platform designed to help you express yourself freely and connect with others. We don't aim to replace any mainstream platforms—we simply offer you another peaceful and harmonious community choice.
solarNetwork.features.title: Powerful Features
solarNetwork.features.desc: From daily social interactions to interest-based communities, Solian provides you with a complete social experience.
solarNetwork.features.timeline.title: Timeline
solarNetwork.features.timeline.desc: Browse posts in chronological order, by popularity, or by our smart recommendation algorithm that learns your preferences. Follow people you're interested in and get their latest updates in real-time. Never miss a moment with customizable feed filters and sorting options.
solarNetwork.features.reactions.title: Reactions
solarNetwork.features.reactions.desc: Go beyond simple likes with a rich set of expressive reactions. From love and laughter to surprise and contemplation, convey your true emotions on every post. React to comments too, making conversations more engaging and meaningful.
solarNetwork.features.posts.title: Posts, Articles & Moments
solarNetwork.features.posts.desc: Multiple content types for every expression need. Share quick thoughts with short posts, write in-depth stories with rich articles, or capture fleeting moments with ephemeral stories. Support for Markdown, images, videos, and embedded content.
solarNetwork.features.chat.title: Instant Messaging
solarNetwork.features.chat.desc: Real-time encrypted chat with support for one-on-one and group conversations. Share text, images, voice messages, files, and stickers. Create group chats with up to 500 members for lively discussions with like-minded people.
solarNetwork.features.realms.title: Realms
solarNetwork.features.realms.desc: Interest-based communities where you can find like-minded people. Each realm is a themed space with its own timeline, rules, and moderators. Join realms matching your hobbies, professions, or interests, or create your own to build a community.
solarNetwork.features.oauth.title: OAuth Integration
solarNetwork.features.oauth.desc: Secure third-party authentication using industry-standard OAuth 2.0 protocol. Sign in with your existing accounts from trusted providers—no need to create yet another password. Your credentials stay protected with bank-level encryption.
solarNetwork.features.checkin.title: Check-in
solarNetwork.features.checkin.desc: Share your location and daily status with friends. Daily check-ins create a personal timeline of your adventures and help you discover interesting places and events nearby. Earn badges for consistent check-ins and explore new locations.
solarNetwork.features.countdown.title: Countdown
solarNetwork.features.countdown.desc: Never miss important dates again. Set countdowns for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and personal milestones. Share countdowns with friends and celebrate together when the moment arrives. Supports recurring events and custom reminders.
solarNetwork.features.polls.title: Polls
solarNetwork.features.polls.desc: Create interactive polls to gather opinions and make community decisions. Choose from single-choice, multiple-choice, or ranked voting formats. Set deadlines, add images to options, and view real-time results with beautiful charts and statistics.
solarNetwork.features.rss.title: RSS Reader
solarNetwork.features.rss.desc: Subscribe to your favorite blogs, news sites, and content creators using RSS feeds. Aggregate all your reading in one beautiful interface. Organize feeds into folders, mark articles as read, and never miss an update from sources you trust.
solarNetwork.features.wallet.title: Wallet
solarNetwork.features.wallet.desc: A built-in points system that rewards your community participation. Earn points by posting, reacting, and engaging with others. Use points to unlock premium features, purchase virtual gifts, or support your favorite creators through tips.
solarNetwork.features.stickers.title: Stickers
solarNetwork.features.stickers.desc: Express yourself with thousands of high-quality stickers. Browse curated collections or create your own custom sticker packs. Animated stickers bring your conversations to life. Share sticker packs with friends and discover new ones from the community.
solarNetwork.features.editor.title: Rich Text Editor
solarNetwork.features.editor.desc: A powerful editor based on Markdown with extended syntax support. Write with live preview, syntax highlighting for code blocks, and support for mathematical formulas. Drag-and-drop image uploads, embedded media, and custom formatting options make content creation effortless.
solarNetwork.features.files.title: File Management
solarNetwork.features.files.desc: Upload, organize, and share files of any type. Images, documents, audio, and video are all supported with generous storage limits. Create shared folders, set access permissions, and manage your digital assets with an intuitive file browser.
solarNetwork.features.social.title: Social Features
solarNetwork.features.social.desc: Complete social graph management with friends lists, follow requests, and blocklists. Control who can see your content, send you messages, or interact with your posts. Privacy settings let you customize your social experience exactly how you want it.
solarNetwork.features.collections.title: Post Collections
solarNetwork.features.collections.desc: Organize and curate your favorite posts into themed collections. Save posts for later reading, create reading lists, and share your curated collections with followers. Perfect for bookmarking recipes, articles, tutorials, or any content you want to revisit.
solarNetwork.features.fediverse.title: Fediverse
solarNetwork.features.fediverse.desc: Connect to the decentralized social web through ActivityPub protocol. Interact seamlessly with users on Mastodon, Pixelfed, Misskey, and other federated platforms. Your content reaches a broader audience while you maintain full control over your data and identity.
solarNetwork.features.achievements.title: Achievements & Progress
solarNetwork.features.achievements.desc: Track your journey with a comprehensive achievement system. Unlock badges for milestones like your first post, community contributions, and streak completions. View your progress on a beautiful profile page and compare achievements with friends.
solarNetwork.features.gallery.title: Photo Gallery
solarNetwork.features.gallery.desc: Showcase your photography in stunning gallery layouts. Create albums, add captions and locations, and share memories with friends. Support for high-resolution images, EXIF data display, and beautiful grid layouts that make your photos shine.
solarNetwork.features.subscription.title: Subscriptions
solarNetwork.features.subscription.desc: Stay updated with your favorite creators through subscriptions. Get instant notifications when they post new content, join live streams, or share exclusive updates. Manage your subscriptions with custom notification preferences and digest emails.
solarNetwork.features.more.title: And More
solarNetwork.features.more.desc: We're constantly innovating based on community feedback. New features ship regularly, from accessibility improvements to experimental tools. Join our beta program to try upcoming features first and help shape the future of Solar Network.
solarNetwork.features.dashboard.title: Dashboard
solarNetwork.features.dashboard.desc: Your personalized command center for everything happening on Solar Network. Track engagement metrics, manage scheduled posts, review notifications, and access quick settings. Beautiful charts and widgets give you insights into your social activity.
solarNetwork.features.events.title: Events
solarNetwork.features.events.desc: Create, discover, and manage events with your community. Set up virtual or in-person gatherings, send invitations, track RSVPs, and share event updates. Never miss birthdays, anniversaries, or special occasions with automatic reminders and celebration features.
solarNetwork.features.eventCalendar.desc: Visualize your schedule in a beautiful calendar interface. See all upcoming events, set reminders, and plan ahead with day, week, and month views. Sync with external calendars and share availability with friends for easy event planning.
solarNetwork.features.presences.title: Profile Presences
solarNetwork.features.presences.desc: Show the world what you're up to right now. Display the music you're listening to, the game you're playing, your current mood, or what you're working on. Rich presence integrations with Spotify, Steam, and other services make your profile come alive.
solarNetwork.aboutCard.peaceful.title: Peaceful & Harmonious
solarNetwork.aboutCard.peaceful.desc: A social space away from the noise, letting you focus on what truly matters—connecting with like-minded people. Here you can quietly share your life without worrying about noise and information overload.
solarNetwork.aboutCard.developer.title: Developer Friendly
solarNetwork.aboutCard.developer.desc: If you're a developer, Solar Network has rich tools for you: native syntax highlighting, code snippet sharing, seamless integration with your favorite development tools. Sharing code has never been easier.
solarNetwork.aboutCard.open.title: Open Ecosystem
solarNetwork.aboutCard.open.desc: We provide fully documented APIs, transparent rate limits, and risk controls. Whether building your own client or developing third-party apps, Solar Network is an ideal starting point.

royIcpFilling.title: ROY ICP Filling
royIcpFilling.tagline: A certified website directory authorized by the Cyberspace Administration of the Republic of Yang.
royIcpFilling.about.title: What is ROY ICP Filling?
royIcpFilling.about.desc: ROY ICP Filling is a community-driven friendly link collection and certification platform authorized by the Republic of Yang's Network Information Office. Any citizen or enterprise can submit their website for review and receive a certified filing number.
royIcpFilling.aboutCard.trusted.title: Trusted Certification
royIcpFilling.aboutCard.trusted.desc: Authorized by the Republic of Yang's Network Information Office, providing official endorsement of internet content quality.
royIcpFilling.aboutCard.community.title: Community Driven
royIcpFilling.aboutCard.community.desc: Open to citizens and enterprises worldwide, building a curated directory of quality websites.
royIcpFilling.aboutCard.open.title: Open Ecosystem
royIcpFilling.aboutCard.open.desc: Fully documented APIs and transparent processes, making integration simple for developers.
royIcpFilling.features.title: Key Features
royIcpFilling.features.desc: Everything you need to certify and list your website in the ROY ICP directory.
royIcpFilling.features.filing.title: Website Filing Application
royIcpFilling.features.filing.desc: Submit your website information for manual or automated review. Once approved, you'll receive an exclusive filing number that certifies your website in the Republic of Yang's cyberspace.
royIcpFilling.features.directory.title: Filing Directory Search
royIcpFilling.features.directory.desc: Browse registered websites by category or keyword. The filing directory is more than just web navigation—it represents an endorsement of internet content quality.
royIcpFilling.features.badge.title: 羝 ICP Badge
royIcpFilling.features.badge.desc: Obtain an exclusive badge after approval to display on your website footer, symbolizing your trusted identity in the Republic of Yang's cyberspace.
royIcpFilling.features.domainChallenge.d: Verify your domain ownership via DNS TXT record challenge. Simple, secure, and automated verification process.
royIcpFilling.features.api.title: Open API
royIcpFilling.features.api.desc: Developers can query filing data via our REST API. See the Suki documentation for details on integration.
royIcpFilling.features.email.title: Email Submission
royIcpFilling.features.email.desc: Prefer not to use the online form? Submit your application via email with all required information.
royIcpFilling.features.global.title: Global Access
royIcpFilling.features.global.desc: Open to citizens and enterprises from any country, not limited to the Republic of Yang.
royIcpFilling.features.security.title: Secure Verification
royIcpFilling.features.security.desc: Domain ownership verified through DNS TXT records, ensuring only legitimate owners can obtain certification.
royIcpFilling.features.automation.title: Automated Process
royIcpFilling.features.automation.desc: System automatically verifies DNS records and processes applications, reducing manual intervention.
royIcpFilling.howToApply.title: Simple Application Process
royIcpFilling.howToApply.desc: Get your website certified in just a few steps.
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step1.title: Submit Application
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step1.desc: Fill out the online form or send us an email with your website details.
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step2.title: Domain Challenge
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step2.desc: Add a DNS TXT record to verify your domain ownership.
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step3.title: Review
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step3.desc: Our team reviews your website for compliance with requirements.
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step4.title: Get Certified
royIcpFilling.howToApply.step4.desc: Receive your filing number and badge to display on your website.
royIcpFilling.requirements.title: Filing Requirements
royIcpFilling.requirements.desc: Your website must meet these basic requirements to obtain ROY ICP Filing.
royIcpFilling.requirements.item1.title: Legal Content
royIcpFilling.requirements.item1.desc: Website content must be legal and compliant, free of malware, fraud, or other illegal information.
royIcpFilling.requirements.item2.title: Accessible Website
royIcpFilling.requirements.item2.desc: The website must be accessible with reasonable availability and uptime.
royIcpFilling.requirements.item3.title: Verifiable Contact
royIcpFilling.requirements.item3.desc: The website owner must provide verifiable contact information.
royIcpFilling.requirements.item4.title: Compliance
royIcpFilling.requirements.item4.desc: Must comply with the regulations of the Republic of Yang's Network Information Office.
royIcpFilling.cta.title: Ready to Get Certified?
royIcpFilling.cta.desc: Join the growing directory of certified websites and earn the trusted 羝 ICP badge for your site.
royIcpFilling.help.title: Need Help?
royIcpFilling.help.desc: Have questions about the filing process? We're here to help.
